purpose: Validate the smallest shipped caller-owned materialization boundary for the physically validated Pulsar UTF-8 real-use candidate. This session does not repeat P7C physical UI behavior. It validates only path canonicalization, exact current-document surface derivation, bounded contract materialization, exact plan selection and separation from planner, perception and Computer Control.
requiredClaims: only absolute caller-owned document paths are accepted
macOS /var paths are canonicalized only to the bounded /private/var alias and other absolute paths are preserved
the Pulsar current-document window title is derived exactly from caller-owned filename and canonical parent path
the only promoted target is UTF-8
the exact postcondition remains UTF-16 LE
the raw caller contract contains no coordinates and no concrete provider identity
provider requirements remain declarative local text-region only
selection reuses the P6C scoped exact application + OPEN + target boundary
TextEdit, JavaScript and other app/target combinations receive no contract
missing or invalid document context fails closed before selection
planner data is not mutated and contains no scope, surface precondition, postcondition, provider request or coordinates
the new materializer does not invoke perception, Computer Control, agent-loop execution or pointer delivery
Computer Use and Computer Control product trees remain clean
nonClaims: This session is contract-only and is not a new physical UI validation.
P7D does not authorize generic Pulsar status-bar clicking.
P7D does not authorize the JavaScript target discovered by P7A/P7B.
P7D does not select an encoding from the modal; the validated action only opens the selector.
P7D does not infer the caller document path from the current window or from Vision; the caller must supply it.
P7D does not place provider identity, scope, postcondition, surface identity or coordinates in planner output.
P7D does not change Computer Control.
P7D does not yet auto-wire normal runTask calls; a later checkpoint must define the explicit caller-context ingress before automatic use.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose exactly, fix forward and create s02. Do not weaken exact title/target/postcondition matching.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: No screenshot, OCR payload, semantic snapshot or coordinates are required by this contract-only session. Synthetic absolute paths only are used by the P7D tests.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P7E explicit caller-context ingress and normal runTask integration for the single Pulsar UTF-8 candidate
